title: Classic Mediterranean Pasta
description: A simple yet flavorful pasta dish inspired by the Mediterranean region, perfect for a quick and satisfying meal. This recipe combines juicy tomatoes with crispy vegetables and savory cheese, all on top of al dente penne pasta.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the penne pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the crushed tomatoes, mediterranean seasoning, and a pinch of salt.
Simmer the sauce for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the juicy cherry tomatoes and crispy chopped bell peppers to the sauce.
Toss the cooked penne pasta with the sauce until well coated.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and top with grated parmesan cheese.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
